Compare Forex Prop Firms

Select up to four firms and compare the real challenge, offer, review, platform, and payout fields available in Prop Firm Lenz’s datasets.

—Forex firms—tracked challenges4comparison slots

Each firm can be selected once. Choose “Add a firm” to leave a slot open.

Comparison methodology

Trustpilot values use the site’s external rating snapshot. Challenge terms use the lowest-priced tracked 100K, two-step entry for each selected firm. LENZ offers come from the current offer catalog. Payout figures use matching firm rows from the embedded payout snapshot; unavailable values remain an em dash.

Before choosing a firm

  • Confirm the current rules and eligibility with the firm.
  • Compare drawdown type as well as the headline price.
  • Treat payout volume as activity data, not a quality guarantee.

Compare Firms FAQ

Which challenge does the comparison use?

It uses the lowest-priced 100K, two-step challenge currently present in the site’s challenge dataset for that firm.

Why does a field show an em dash?

The site does not have a verified value for that firm and field. Missing values are never estimated.

Are payout totals a guarantee of future payouts?

No. They show tracked historical activity for the displayed snapshot and do not predict future results.

Can I compare more than four firms?

You can compare four at a time. Change any selector to review another firm without reloading the page.

Spread status: not tracked yet. No spread figure on this page is copied, inferred, or estimated.

How to read spread data

A spread is the difference between the bid and ask price. It can vary by instrument, platform, account type, liquidity, and market conditions. Comparable measurements require a consistent observation window and account setup.

Methodology

Firm names, logos, platforms, and Trustpilot values come from the site’s existing datasets. Spread cells remain “Not tracked yet” until a verified, consistently measured dataset is available. Rank follows the directory order and is not a spread-performance ranking.

i

Additional Information

Low advertised spreads do not describe total trading cost on their own. Commissions, slippage, execution, instrument hours, and each firm’s current rules can materially change the effective cost.

Spreads FAQ

Why are all spread cells blank?

Prop Firm Lenz does not yet have a verified spread dataset. The em dash is an honest unavailable state, not a zero spread.

Are the platform listings verified?

They are rendered from the platform fields already stored for each Forex firm in the site’s directory dataset.

Can spreads change during the day?

Yes. Spreads can widen around news, session changes, rollover, and lower-liquidity periods.

Does the lowest spread mean the best firm?

No. Compare total cost, challenge rules, drawdown, platform access, reviews, and payout history together.

How we compare firms

This September 21, 2026 snapshot brings the supplied firm data into one consistent comparison.

  • Popularity uses the recorded favorite counts.
  • Ratings and review totals are shown exactly as captured in the source dataset.
  • Challenge views compare published assets, platforms, maximum allocations, and discounts.
  • The public comparison is limited to Forex firms represented in the site’s directory and challenge datasets.

How We Rank Firms

Firms are ranked by their Trustpilot TrustScore. Ties are broken by Trustpilot review count, from highest to lowest.

Trustpilot ratings and counts are kept separate from Prop Firm Lenz community reviews. If reliable Trustpilot data is unavailable, the table shows an em dash and places the firm after rated firms.

How We Verify and Rank Firms

Prop Firm Lenz displays tracked blockchain payout records from the embedded payout dataset. Table totals and payout counts are ranked only from the selected timeframe, while Trustpilot scores remain a separate external snapshot.

  • Tracked records are not firm-submitted claims.
  • Missing payout metrics remain blank instead of being estimated.
  • Category counts include only firms that can be matched to the site’s firm directory.
  • Use payout history alongside current firm rules and verified reviews.

Report a delayed payout

Prop Firm Lenz doesn’t accept a payout report directly on this page. Use the existing Help Center or Contact Us section to share the firm name and supporting details for review.
